correctness.rationale: For a single recoloring a→b the change in energy is J(N_a−N_b); at a degree-three vertex strict stability is equivalent to N_a≥2. On a mixed rung this forces both respective row neighbors to agree, propagating the same ordered pair around the cycle. Otherwise the monochromatic rungs form a cyclic word without singleton runs. In the latter case the r run boundaries are nonadjacent edges and there are (n/r) binom(n−r−1,r−1) placements for r≥2; the run-color factor is (q−1)^r+(q−1)(−1)^r, including the two-run case. The cyclic matching recurrence gives the two Lucas terms, and the exceptional q(q−1) states have H/J=n and W=0. At u=1 the dominant root λ is separated in modulus from λ−1, roots of modulus 1 and the constant term. Analytic continuation gives a uniform exponential error near u=1. If λ(t)(λ(t)−1)=(q−1)e^t, then (log λ)'=(λ−1)/(2λ−1) and (log λ)''=λ(λ−1)/(2λ−1)^3. The expansion at t/√n establishes the fixed-q CLT; the exceptional states have exponentially small probability, so the energy limits follow. This covers the n=3 simple cycle, labeled states, and strictly positive recoloring cost, not neutral moves or dynamical sampling. Inspected RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md and verify_potts_ladder.py; the finite census (2,123,582 configurations) and transfer checks are source-reported, not rerun or used to prove generality.

originality.rationale: A distinct Resultary record gives the same classification, unweighted count, and exact count refined by the number of runs. A nonconstant monochromatic-rung word with r runs has exactly W=r and H/J=2r. The refined polynomial is a direct relabeling of the prior coefficients, including the known exceptional and consensus counts. The prior generating-function proof also yields the marked roots by the single substitution w(z)→u w(z). Its isolated dominant quadratic root yields the quoted LLN, entropy, and Gaussian constants by routine analytic moment expansion; the asymptotes are not claimed to have been explicitly printed in the earlier record. The overlap is mathematical and does not depend on a publication-priority inference.
